'''Honoghr''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Bust Collection" /> located in the [[Honoghr system]] in the [[Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> that was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Noghri]] [[species]].<ref name="Alien Archive" /> During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[327th Star Corps]] fought a [[Battle of Honoghr|battle on Honoghr]].<ref name="Bust Collection" />
